question:
Study the given figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/853616fa28caa979f1328de2247fccb8c3e98295a4e8726df4b57fa592a789b8.png] 

What is the distance between the centres of the given circles?
solution:
**Given:**

AC (radius left) = 6 cm

BD (radius right) = 11 cm

CD (top horizontal) = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

Horizontal = CD

Vertical = |BD − AC|

Distance AB = √(Horizontal² + Vertical²)

**Calculations:**

Vertical = |11 − 6| = 5 cm

Horizontal = 10 cm

⇒ AB = √(10² + 5²)

⇒ AB = √(100 + 25) = √125

⇒ AB = 5√5 cm 

**∴ Distance between the centres = 5√5 cm .**
